Name: HungerAndThirst
Author: primevaltitmouse
Description:
Ever thought Stardew Valley was too easy? Wished there was a use for your watering can once you got sprinklers?

You will slowly lose food and water over time; exercise will increase the loss! You'll even lose food and water while sleeping, so if you're sleeping through a whole day, make sure you've eaten! Running out of food will double stamina costs, while running out of water will cost health! Eat any food to regain your food, and drink from your watering can, drinks you've made, or water sources! Upgrading your watering can will increase its capacity for drinking!

Downloads.Description: Updated for Stardew Valley 1.2 and SMAPI 1.10
